name: app-user-research-charts-with-soft-gauges
title: User research slide with soft-fade bars, a semicircle gauge and a step chart
whatItIs: A light-grey case-study page with question headings and three white chart cards: horizontal bars fading to pink, a semicircle gauge with green, red and grey segments, and a staircase chart. It ends with a user quote and avatar.
whatItMeans: Analytical but gentle; the fading gradients make data feel soft rather than harsh.
techniques: Fade chart bars to transparency for a light, airy data look.
Ask the survey question as a heading above each chart card.
Use uncommon chart shapes (semicircle, staircase) to add interest.
Close with a highlighted user quote.

vocabulary.definition: A chart where values step up or down like stairs.
A bar with a gradient that fades out.
Using the actual question as a chart title.
